title: •Veers
caption: •Veers (V)
game_text: {pilot:4}. Deploys -2 to Hoth. Your combat vehicles are defense value +1 at same and related locations. While on Hoth, your AT-ATs and Imperials are deploy -1 and forfeit +1 at related locations.
lore: General of the AT-AT assault armor division sent by Darth Vader to crush the Rebellion on Hoth. Cold and ruthless.
expansion: The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game
copyright: TM & © 1996 LUCASFILM LTD. TM, ® & © 1996 DECIPHER INC.
notes: Unique. Base is the ESB Introductory Two-Player Game Veers (premium), not Hoth's General Veers. Stats POWER 3 / ABILITY 3 / FORCE-ATTUNED (label only); deploy 3 / forfeit 5. Yellow DS pilot-power icon followed by '4.' at the start → {pilot:4} (stub expands 'Adds 4 to power of anything he pilots'). Icon column top to bottom: pilot, warrior (printed card has warrior only). Imperial (Imperial disc top-left). Lore matches the scan. The ESB2P card prints a small silver/grey expansion sphere in the ring beside the lore box (the ESB Two-Player symbol; no icon cut yet). Copyright reads 1996 on the scan, read at zoom. Base scan only at 350 px. Modern: V6-D-veers.gif (745 px) is the Virtual Set 6 Veers (V) — a different text but the same art and lore; VB2-D-veers-pre.gif (350, Virtual Block 2) also downloaded to modern/.
